Reference values for MFO and Fatmax

Source: R/reference_MFO.R
reference_MFO.Rd

Published percentiles of maximal fat oxidation (MFO) and Fatmax in sedentary adults: Table 1 of Amaro-Gahete, Sanchez-Delgado and Ruiz (2018) doi:10.3389/fphys.2018.01460 , 167 healthy sedentary adults (107 women) tested on a treadmill. One row per group of the table: all participants, by sex, by age group, by sex and age group, and by weight status. The percentiles are empirical (P20, P40, P60, P80), not derived from the mean and SD. Every row carries the test conditions, because a percentile is only meaningful against a reference measured in the same way (SPEC 15.2).

The source does not print the cut-offs of its groups: age groups are the young (22.1 +/- 2.2 years, n = 125) and middle-aged (52.1 +/- 4.6 years, n = 42) cohorts, and weight status (normal weight, overweight, obese) has no published BMI thresholds. Groups are therefore chosen explicitly, never deduced from a numeric age or BMI.

Where the text and Table 1 disagree (Fatmax by weight status, SD of MFO in middle-aged adults), the table is used.

Usage

data(reference_MFO)

Format

A data frame with 12 rows and 25 variables:

cohort

source of the row, `"Amaro-Gahete 2018"`

grouping

grouping criterion as printed in Table 1: `"All"`, `"By Sex"`, `"By Age"`, `"By Sex and Age"` or `"By BMI Status"`

population

group label as printed in Table 1

sex

`"male"`, `"female"` or `NA` (both)

age_group

`"young"`, `"middle-aged"` or `NA` (both)

weight_status

`"normal"`, `"overweight"`, `"obese"` or `NA` (all)

n

number of participants in the group

MFO_mean, MFO_sd

MFO mean and SD, in g/min

MFO_p20, MFO_p40, MFO_p60, MFO_p80

MFO percentiles, in g/min

Fatmax_mean, Fatmax_sd

Fatmax mean and SD, in % VO2max

Fatmax_p20, Fatmax_p40, Fatmax_p60, Fatmax_p80

Fatmax percentiles, in % VO2max

mode

exercise mode, `"walking"` (treadmill)

protocol

graded protocol and averaging period

equation

stoichiometric equation, Frayn (1983) without protein

method

third-degree polynomial with intersection at (0;0) (Croci et al. 2014), unlike the unconstrained `"P3"` of [MFO()]

fasting

fasting before the test, 5-6 h (not overnight)

doi

DOI of the source

Source

Amaro-Gahete FJ, Sanchez-Delgado G, Ruiz JR (2018). Commentary: Contextualising maximal fat oxidation during exercise: determinants and normative values. *Front Physiol* 9:1460, Table 1. doi:10.3389/fphys.2018.01460 . Built by `data-raw/reference_MFO.R`.

Examples

data(reference_MFO, package = "MFO")
reference_MFO[, c("population", "n", "MFO_p20", "MFO_p80")]
#>                           population   n MFO_p20 MFO_p80
#> 1                   Sedentary adults 167    0.24    0.42
#> 2                Sedentary adult men  60    0.29    0.44
#> 3              Sedentary adult women 107    0.24    0.40
#> 4             Sedentary young adults 125    0.28    0.44
#> 5       Sedentary middle-aged adults  42    0.22    0.38
#> 6          Sedentary young adult men  41    0.28    0.48
#> 7        Sedentary young adult women  84    0.28    0.42
#> 8    Sedentary middle-aged adult men  19    0.29    0.42
#> 9  Sedentary middle-aged adult women  23    0.22    0.27
#> 10    Normal-weight sedentary adults  88    0.25    0.42
#> 11       Overweight sedentary adults  50    0.24    0.41
#> 12            Obese sedentary adults  29    0.26    0.45
